Energy continues to display pristine momentum, anchored by Oil & Gas Integrated (0.917 momentum, YTD rank 4) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.889 momentum, YTD rank 7). Healthcare also exhibits sustained strength via Health Information Services and Medical Care Facilities. Concurrently, business and consumer services are staging aggressive short-term advances, led by Department Stores (+19 spots to rank 46) and Staffing & Employment Services (+17 spots to rank 9).

Conversely, industrials, precious metals, and materials are fading sharply. Metal Fabrication plunged 43 spots (rank 91), Silver dropped 34 spots (rank 79), and Engineering & Construction fell 31 spots (rank 82). While power-related utilities and Uranium languish at the bottom of the momentum rankings, beaten-down real estate and residential groups are beginning to post early signs of upward rank velocity.

## Strength
- **Broad Market Breadth:** 32 of 144 industry groups maintain all-green status across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD timeframes.
- **Persistent Energy Dominance:** Oil & Gas Integrated (0.917 momentum) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.889 momentum) remain top all-green performers with sustained multi-month rank strength alongside Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.
- **Healthcare & Software Anchors:** Health Information Services (0.864 momentum, rank 15) and Healthcare Plans (0.81 momentum) lead an all-green healthcare complex, while Software - Application and Medical Distribution maintain top-36 rank persistence across 1, 3, and 6 months.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Ascents:** Department Stores gained 19 spots (rank 46, 0.869 momentum), Rental & Leasing Services rose 18 spots (rank 45, 0.60 momentum), and Waste Management advanced 18 spots (rank 60, 0.77 momentum).
- **Steep Industrial & Metal Sell-Offs:** Metal Fabrication collapsed 43 spots to rank 91 (0.20 momentum), followed by deep 5-session drops in Silver (-34 spots to rank 79), Engineering & Construction (-31 spots to rank 82), and Gold (-30 spots to rank 104).
- **Entrenched Momentum Laggards:** Uranium (0.072 momentum, YTD rank 131), Advertising Agencies (0.079 momentum, YTD rank 144), and Resorts & Casinos (0.093 momentum, YTD rank 138) sit at the absolute bottom of relative performance.

## Divergences
- **Emerging Bottom-Fishers:** Real estate and building plays are jumping in 5-day rank despite low baseline momentum, including REIT - Office (+10 spots, 0.44 momentum), Residential Construction (+8 spots, 0.43 momentum), and Home Improvement Retail (+7 spots, 0.43 momentum).
- **High-Momentum Slippage:** Insurance - Reinsurance (0.76 momentum, -2 spots), Medical Distribution (0.75 momentum, -2 spots), and Tobacco (0.64 momentum, -4 spots) show early signs of fatigue with declining 5-day ranks.
- **Fragile Leadership:** Diagnostics & Research holds all-green status but displays vulnerability with a low rank agreement score of 0.50.
